mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE crossing above 9.5% triggers a labor market tightening effect, reducing corporate profits and equity valuations, causing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 9.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in GDPC1 (demand) and HOUST (demand) signals robust economic activity, driving investor optimism and positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The two proxies (GDPC1 and HOUST) do not move together, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a supply-side expansion (INDPRO > 102), increased production capacity reduces inflationary pressures, fostering market confidence and positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not exceed 102 or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during supply-side expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% triggers a tightening cycle, raising interest rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS spikes above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concomitant declines in UNRATE and PAYEMS signal labor market softening, reducing corporate earnings growth and equity valuations, resulting in negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE and PAYEMS do not move inversely, or 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in INDPRO over the past 6 months indicates robust supply-side growth, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not trend upward or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: GDPC1 increasing by more than 1% in the next month signals a demand surge, driving corporate earnings growth and investor optimism, resulting in positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases by more than 1% in the next month
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not increase by >1% next month or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
